data_model.Printer: manufacturer + model + optional sourced hardware fields + source metadata
data_model.Filament: material family or branded product + optional sourced settings + source metadata
data_model.Profile: printer + filament + slicer + nozzle + goal + typed settings/provenance + classification; reserved for V2/V3, no personal data in V1
data_model.CalibrationResult: printer + filament + nozzle + slicer + test + inputs + result + final setting + notes + date; reserved for V3
data_model.TechnicalSource: URL + source type + checked date + status + claim scope + review notes + superseded source
data_model.ContactMessage: public contact submission, owner reviews in dashboard

source_system.policy: Source-checked means page reviewed, never physical testing. Conflicting records retain original values and receive needs_review status. No numerical settings without supporting source and scope.

tool_architecture: Pure calculation engine separate from definitions, forms and result interpretation. User inputs never treated as official. Temperature/retraction generators export test schedules, not machine-ready G-code or STL; native slicer creates printable model.
troubleshooting_architecture: Ten curated problem records: symptom, causes, checks, recommended test, interpretation, next parameter, retest and sources. Session context stays in memory/URL, notes export locally; accounts and persistent history deferred.
seo: Semantic titles, descriptions, crawlable internal links, real content only, no invented public canonical URL.
future_security: Before enabling V2 administration or V3 personal storage, add authenticated roles and ownership policies. No private profile writes exposed by V1 UI.
